title: 2012 Topps Chrome #71 Courtney Upshaw Baltimore Ravens Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2012 Topps Chrome trading card features Courtney Upshaw of the Baltimore Ravens, card number 71. It is a part of the base set and also considered a rookie card. The card is from the National Football League (NFL) and manufactured by Topps. 

This sports trading card is perfect for collectors who are fans of football and the Baltimore Ravens. It is a great addition to any collection and can be easily purchased from the Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop category. Get your hands on this card from the 2012 season and add it to your collection today!
